text: CI (Ubuntu, R 4.6.1) fails at lazy-load: object 'as.matrix_dataset' is not exported by namespace:fmridataset. fmridataset main (937e193, 2026-09-07) removed fmri_dataset, matrix_dataset, fmri_mem_dataset, latent_dataset, get_data/get_data_matrix/get_mask, data_chunks/exec_strategy/collect_chunks, read_fmri_config, sampling-frame accessors, fmri_series, fmri_group; the frame API (fmri_frame, collect_assay, temporal_schema, plan_blocks, basis_synthesis) replaces them. R/fmridataset-imports.R and NAMESPACE importFrom lines are the immediate load failure. Migration in progress on branch migrate/fmri-frame (worktree from origin/master). Also on the docket: src/ols_t.cpp:32 unused variable P warning.
